market_story: imports (PJM/South priced seams): MISO is a large net importer over the eastern (PJM) seam and a net exporter over the southern (TVA-dominated) seam; the measured (month x hod) EIA-930 deliverability envelope is a merit-order CEILING, so the cheap base import rungs clear first and the envelope's residual falls on the expensive rungs — the real seam clears its merit order below the ceiling, not all-or-nothing. Restoring that price-to-depth pairing (the uniform per-band derate broke it) recovers the priced-seam import volume: net-interchange err -5.5/-7.4/-7.3 -> -0.6/-1.2/-2.4 TWh, PJM and South both toward measured every year. imports (Manitoba): the MISO-Manitoba tie is a scheduled two-way seasonal hydro exchange (freshet/summer import, winter export to winter-peaking Manitoba, net export in the 2025 drought); the same merit-order ceiling un-suppresses Manitoba's own deep import rungs, so the measured Q-Q ladder + two-way envelope reproduce the revealed schedule more faithfully than miso-74 (fixing its annual-net miss). CC_REGULAR: MISO gas-CC serves in band — the seam family now carries the correct interchange volume with the right merit order, no over-import displacing domestic CC (rule 11). Zero fitted scalars: a composition-semantics gate over two already-measured mechanisms.
